## Goal
- Extend IVX autonomous coder from a PATCH engine into a FACTORY engine that can build apps from scratch, install deps, provision Supabase, run builds, create tools, self-upgrade, AND persist factory-created files to GitHub — wire REAL runners, prove end-to-end live, build + ship latest APK; sync GITHUB_TOKEN into IVX encrypted ownerVariablesStore for durability

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use `node:zlib` `gzipSync`; use `node tmp/commit-*.mjs` scripts (ES modules, `.mjs` extension)
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Render env var upsert: `{action: "render_upsert_env_var", input: {serviceId, key, value}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE"}` — calls Render PUT `/v1/services/{id}/env-vars/{key}`; requires deploy to materialize
- APK upload: owner-gated `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` → returns presigned S3 PUT URL → PUT APK → verify via HEAD on public URL (does NOT require AWS credentials in sandbox — presign is server-side)
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h; sandbox resets may wipe `/tmp/owner_at` — re-mint when missing)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Owner-AI POST requires `{"message": "..."}` field (NOT `"prompt"`)
- Dedup: resubmitting same prompt to `/api/ivx/owner-ai` returns existing job — use unique runId in prompt
- `bun test backend/` = 1605 tests / 0 fail (5999 expects); factory tests = 33 pass / 0 fail
- Scoped typecheck: `tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler <files>` (NOT `--module nodenext` which causes TS1470)
- Plan_md: `.rork/plans/stop-kotlin-work-expo-app-is-the-only-mo_1784341475573.plan.md` (81 lines now); lines start with `- [x]` or `- [ ]` (NO leading spaces)
- Watchman workaround: `mv /usr/local/bin/watchman /usr/local/bin/watchman.disabled` — proven for sandbox gradle builds
- GITHUB_TOKEN provided by owner via secure requestEnvs box; token is private env — NOT visible in sandbox bash, injected into Render runtime on deploy
- GitHub commits sometimes hit transient 503 — retry with backoff (5s × attempt number)
- Backend experienced intermittent 503s this session (Render restarts) — health check retry loop needed; `/health/queue` endpoint shows worker status (`running`, `depth`, `saturated`, `staleQueue`, `lastTickAt`)
- Owner variable encryption key sources in priority order: `IVX_OWNER_VARIABLES_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, `APP_SECRET`, `JWT_SECRET` (backend/api/ivx-owner-variables.ts:191,198,210)

## Progress
### Done
- **FACTORY ENGINE BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, AND PROVEN LIVE** (prior sessions):
  - `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory.ts` — 7 operation kinds: `create_directory`, `create_module`, `install_dependency`, `run_supabase_migration`, `run_build`, `create_tool`, `upgrade_self`
  - 33 regression tests ALL PASS; 8 base capabilities; tool registry; path guards
  - Prior commits: `e1deca44` + `04f54652` + `8fa36ef0` + `1f628490` + `56a3d061`
  - Prior live proof: job `ivx-worker-2e87f468` COMPLETED (create_tool + upgrade_self)

- **REAL FACTORY RUNNERS MODULE + WORKER WIRING** (prior session, this session fixed):
  - `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory-runners.ts` — `realMigrationRunner` (Supabase Mgmt API `/database/query`), `realDependencyRunner` (package.json edit), `realBuildRunner` (gradlew/bun), `commitFactoryFilesToGitHub`, `getRealFactoryRunners`
  - Worker wiring in `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: runners injected into `runIVXFactoryJob()`; post-factory GitHub commit when `approved && filesCreated.length > 0 && finalStatus === 'COMPLETED'`
  - Owner-ai extractor in `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` parses `create_module` + `run_supabase_migration` from prompt text

- **FACTORY COMMIT GAP DIAGNOSED AND CLOSED** (this session):
  - Root cause: `commitFactoryFilesToGitHub` used `readEnv()` (process.env ONLY) but working `github_commit_file` action uses `readRuntimeVariable()` (process.env + ownerVariablesStore fallback via `getIVXOwnerVariableRuntimeValue`)
  - Fix: new `readOwnerRuntimeVariable()` function in factory-runners.ts — checks process.env FIRST, then dynamic import of `../api/ivx-owner-variables` → `getIVXOwnerVariableRuntimeValue()` as fallback; also added structured console.log failure diagnostics + per-file skip on disk-missing
  - Commit `58866d36` — the `readOwnerRuntimeVariable` fix
  - Commit `2ca8604e` — added `factoryCommitDiagnostics` field to `IVXWorkerJobResult` type (stepReached, approved, filesCreatedCount, finalStatus, commitAttempted, commitOk, commitError, commitSha)
  - LIVE PROOF SUCCESS: job `ivx-worker-076f4d88-d7a6-4fec-a05c-267afc1b6a8b`, COMMIT SHA: `4bee0c04713c2839a2c72febf28db7a519293feb`, proof file `backend/services/ivx-factory-commit-proof.ts` LANDED ON GITHUB ✅ (verified via GitHub API HTTP 200, file in commit tree)

- **APK v1.4.19(51) BUILT + UPLOADED + VERIFIED LIVE** (this session):
  - Version bumped in `expo/app.config.ts` (v1.4.19, versionCode 51, buildMarker `IVX_BUNDLE_2026_07_20_BUILD_51_FACTORY_COMMIT_GAP_FIXED_LIVE_PROOF`) + `expo/android/app/build.gradle` (versionCode 51, versionName "1.4.19")
  - gradle assembleRelease BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 13s (424 tasks: 30 executed, 394 up-to-date)
  - APK 82,906,491 bytes, md5 `2330a17469b378b0921fffb816ece6c7`, sha256 `00627e14a259f3aaeda1990f43e5b8b979e70955f2a51cedb02d645447280373`
  - Uploaded via owner-gated presign-upload → S3 PUT 200 (etag matches md5)
  - Verified at `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.19.apk` — HTTP 200, Content-Length 82906491 exact match, S3 ETag `2330a17469b378b0921fffb816ece6c7` matches local md5
  - Version bump committed to GitHub: `expo/app.config.ts` → `fa9947bed8f7af192e093d34d2940e13fb3e356e`, `expo/android/app/build.gradle` → `82fff76b49f2ccf27eeb59caac6b4b3c804b6902` (GitHub HEAD now `82fff76b`)
  - Scripts: `tmp/upload-apk-v1.4.19.mjs`, `tmp/commit-version-bump.mjs`

- **OWNER VARIABLES STATUS DIAGNOSED** (this session):
  - GITHUB_TOKEN + GITHUB_REPO_URL both `presentInRuntime: true, runtimeSource: process_env` (that's why factory commit `4bee0c04` worked)
  - `encryptionConfigured: false` — the IVX ownerVariablesStore encrypted Supabase store CANNOT be written because `IVX_OWNER_VARIABLES_ENCRYPTION_KEY` / `APP_SECRET` / `JWT_SECRET` are NOT in Render's process.env
  - Self-sync endpoint `POST /api/ivx/owner-variables/self-sync` with `{names: ['GITHUB_TOKEN', 'GITHUB_REPO_URL'], overwriteExisting: true}` FAILED with "Owner Variables encryption key is missing"
  - `render_upsert_env_var` action identified as the way to set the encryption key on Render (phrase `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE`)

- **ALL COMMITS THIS SESSION** (via owner-gated GitHub API):
  - `58866d36` — fix: factory commit gap (readOwnerRuntimeVariable fallback)
  - `2ca8604e` — feat: factory commit diagnostics field
  - `4bee0c04` — factory-created proof file (autonomous factory commit, NOT manual)
  - `fa9947be` — chore: bump app.config.ts to v1.4.19(51)
  - `82fff76b` — chore: bump build.gradle to v1.4.19(51)

- **PRIOR SESSION AUTONOMOUS COMMITS (still true)**:
  - `07230677` — autonomous coder new module; `045ff50c` — bug-fix; `eb3749a4` — PILOT-2→PILOT-3; `99dfafd4` — 3 root cause fixes
  - `019aada0` — real factory runners module; `a7dbfe0f` — app.config.ts versionCode 48→50; `3295d0d4` — wire real factory runners into worker; `2a91c428` — owner-ai factory extractor; `10175d17` — real migration runner Supabase Mgmt API fix

- **ENGINE HARDENING (still true)**: cost controls, per-stage timeouts, cancellation, heartbeat, production rollback, proof fields

### In Progress
- **GITHUB_TOKEN SYNC INTO IVX ENCRYPTED OWNER VARIABLES STORE** — script `tmp/sync-github-token-e2e.mjs` written (5-step: generate enc key → `render_upsert_env_var` → `render_trigger_deploy` → wait for backend → self-sync → verify status); fixed import bug (`readFileSync` from `node:fs` not `node:crypto`); NOT yet executed — backend was recovering from 503s
- **FRESH FACTORY E2E PROOF** — script `tmp/factory-e2e-final-proof.mjs` written (creates unique module + Supabase table + factory commit, polls job, verifies on GitHub); multiple attempts failed due to backend 503s and job dedup returning stuck QUEUED job; stuck job `ivx-worker-3084e314-2c65-406b-b5fe-07dc59c101df` was CANCELLED; ready to relaunch with backend now healthy

### Blocked
- Backend intermittent 503s (Render restarts) caused factory e2e proof jobs to get stuck QUEUED; worker eventually recovers (`running:true, depth:0`) but timing is unpredictable

## Key Decisions
- Factory commit fix uses `readOwnerRuntimeVariable()` that reads process.env FIRST then ownerVariablesStore fallback — mirrors the working `github_commit_file` action's credential path exactly
- To sync GITHUB_TOKEN into the encrypted store, must first set `IVX_OWNER_VARIABLES_ENCRYPTION_KEY` on Render via `render_upsert_env_var` + deploy, THEN self-sync can encrypt + store the token durably
- The token already works from process.env (proven by commit `4bee0c04`), so the encrypted store sync is for DURABILITY not functional necessity

## Next Steps
1. Execute `tmp/sync-github-token-e2e.mjs` to set encryption key on Render → deploy → self-sync GITHUB
